description: Instant utilisation (demand/capacity) of a standard steel connection under the given member-end forces, from capacities precomputed with finite-element connection analysis to AISC 360-16 LRFD (S275 steel, grade 8.8 bolts, C30/37 concrete). Returns the utilisation, the governing component (and the governing plate, weld or bolt group) and warnings. Call without "template" to list the templates and sizes. Only for a joint where no other member frames in: if anything else connects at the node, the result does not apply (ask for a connection design instead). For a first idea of a connection; a design for construction needs a checked calculation.

My_kNm.description: Major-axis moment at the node, kNm (moment templates only). Positive = top flange of the beam in tension (hogging).

N_kN.description: Member-end force at the node, kN: the force the loaded member applies to the connection, in member axes (x away from the node). Positive = tension (pulls away from the node).

Vy_kN.description: Base plate only: horizontal shear along the column flanges, kN.

Vz_kN.description: Beams: vertical shear the beam applies to the connection, kN, positive UPWARDS (gravity shear is negative). Base plate: horizontal shear along the column web.

members.description: Section of each member by role, e.g. {"column": "HEA300", "beam": "IPE330"}.

other_members_at_node.description: true if any other member (brace, second beam, etc.) connects at the same node.

template.description: Connection template. Omit to list templates and sizes.

name: check_connection
title: Check a standard steel connection (instant utilisation)
